painting.title: The Triumph of the Name of Jesus
painting.medium: oil on paper, laid down on canvas

subjectRelation.assessment: Exact devotional subject: the IHS monogram is adored by saints and angels; the museum links the ceiling fresco iconography to Philippians 2:10.
subjectRelation.qualification: This is a preparatory oil sketch (bozzetto) for the Gesù church ceiling fresco, not the finished fresco. It represents the Holy Name devotion directly, but does not itself verify that the Holy Name was the 1962 liturgical principal on 4 January 2026.
